name: independent-autobot-worker-contract-v1
purpose: Fan-out specialist execution into independent GitHub Actions workflow runs while preserving the proven specialist edit, verification, recovery and handoff contracts.

productionLane.changePolicy: No automatic dependency on experimental workers.

fanOut.dispatcher: planner/coordination layer chooses bot, objective, baseRef and coordinationId
fanOut.isolation: Each specialist gets its own workflow run, isolated worktree, candidate branch, Aider execution and failure boundary.

fanIn.rule: Every dispatched worker must produce exactly one ledger record; failed workers remain visible and are never silently dropped.
fanIn.codeMerge: Candidate branches remain separate until a verified integration controller explicitly merges them against the recorded base SHA.

resourceIsolation.aider: one Aider process per worker workflow
resourceIsolation.model: worker workflows may use independent local model processes; the current production two-worker run is untouched.
resourceIsolation.failureBoundary: worker failure does not cancel sibling worker workflows.
